name: BlockAmendSpec
lead: What `game.blocks.amend` takes: **hooks only**. Every tnt in every world already looks like tnt and is as hard as tnt, so a data column here is refused by name. For a block of your own with different numbers, `game.blocks.define { extends = "tnt" }`.

functions.name: on_use
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_use((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, held: string ?, base: (... any) -> any) -> Used ?) → ?
functions.description: Somebody right-clicked it; `held` is the item in hand. Answers "used" or "pass"; a missed deadline passes the click through.

functions.name: on_break
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_break((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, by: Breaker, base: (... any) -> any) -> Drops ?) → ?
functions.description: Something broke it; `by` says what. Answers "none", "table" or a drops list.

functions.name: on_step
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_step((block: BlockAt, body: Body, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A body (a player, mob, item or other) is standing on it.

functions.name: on_tick
functions.description: A scheduled tick this block asked for came due.

functions.name: on_random_tick
functions.description: The random pass landed on it.

functions.name: on_place
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_place((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?

functions.name: on_neighbour
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_neighbour((block: BlockAt, from: Vec3, announced: string, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A neighbour at `from` changed; `announced` is the block the notifier announced itself as.

functions.name: on_trigger
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_trigger((block: BlockAt, cause: Trigger, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: It was lit, blasted or burnt; `cause` is "ignite", "explosion" or "fire".

functions.name: on_power
functions.signature: blockAmendSpec.on_power((block: BlockAt, powered: boolean, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A redstone signal started (`powered` is true) or stopped reaching it. Called once for each, not for every change beside it.

functions.name: on_added
functions.description: It has just been stored, whatever stored it.

title: BlockAmendSpec type
